description: Open a SEAL link. `metadata` shows name, size and expiry without consuming a read. `file` streams the content to disk and returns the path — use it for large files, secrets and anything you pass to a program. `inline` returns small JSON/CSV/plain text into the conversation and refuses secrets and HTML/PDF.

dir.description: mode=file: directory to save into; default ~/Downloads, created if missing. An existing file is never overwritten: the new one becomes `name (1).ext`.

item.description: An inbox handle from seal_inbox (`in_…`), instead of a URL.

mode.description: `metadata` reads nothing; `file` saves to disk; `inline` returns small text.

url.description: Full SEAL share URL: its fragment is the key, or there is none on a link sent to this server's address.

name: seal_open
title: Open a SEAL link
